analysis:
## Technical analysis (Monday June 29 — US premarket; bond distribution Day 5 pending)

**No regular session data yet.** SPCX premarket ~$153.38 (+0.81%). Day 5 volume read is pending 9:30 AM ET open.

**Samsung sell-the-news impact on SPCX:** The June 28 framework identified Samsung risk-on as an X-factor that could modestly reduce Day 5 discretionary distribution selling. Samsung KOSPI sell-the-news (−3.4% at open, recovered −0.2%) eliminates this tailwind. Day 5 proceeds at the structural distribution pace without macro support.

**Distribution volume trajectory:** Day 4 (June 26) = 126.91M shares. Without Samsung X-factor, Day 5 est. range: 100–140M shares (vs. prior 60–80M target with Samsung boost). Clearance pace may extend 1–2 sessions beyond July 7 base case.

**IG floor watch:** $150 held on close four consecutive sessions despite two intraday breaches. Without Samsung bid support, intraday $147–$149 range tests remain possible. Two closing breaches trigger framework reassessment.

**Nasdaq 100 July 7 unchanged:** On schedule. Samsung sell-the-news reduces probability of early clearance, making July 7 arrival into still-active distribution more likely (as occurred with Russell 1000 on June 26).

**Peripheral positive:** Micron +15.7% provides Nasdaq tech bid supporting SPCX premarket — unrelated to distribution mechanics but supports the long-term AI connectivity thesis for September 2.

so_what.line: Samsung's sell-the-news removes the only macro tailwind that could have helped Day 5 — sit on your hands, watch the volume read at open, and don't mistake a premarket $1 pop for anything other than Micron pulling tech higher.
so_what.bull: The Nasdaq 100 add arriving precisely as distribution clears in July remains the best structural setup of the year — four consecutive $150 floor holds with no Samsung help show the institutional bid is real and endogenous.
so_what.bear: The Russell 1000 reconstitution ate $4 billion in passive buying and still closed at $152 — expect the same mechanics on July 7, and the Samsung boost just got cancelled, so Day 5 distribution volume may extend the clearance timeline into late July.
